2026_04_ATL_NO.headline: Atlanta and New Orleans bring an NFC South quarterback test to Monday night
2026_04_ATL_NO.paragraph1: Atlanta travels to New Orleans with Kevin Stefanski’s offense still trying to establish dependable quarterback rhythm, while the Saints prepare Tyler Shough for a divisional game that can be decided by protection and early-down efficiency. Atlanta’s secondary gives it a route to squeeze explosive throws if the front can create pressure without overcommitting. New Orleans needs to keep Shough out of obvious passing downs and make Atlanta defend the full width of the field rather than letting the Falcons dictate tempo.
2026_04_ATL_NO.model_rationale: The matchup turns on which offense protects its quarterback and avoids predictable passing situations, with both defenses positioned to punish stalled early-down execution.
